name: @autobroker/desktop
description: Layer 5 (app) — dev-solo Electron shell: a thin main process that forks the self-contained server bundle (bundle/server.cjs) as a utilityProcess and loads the built SPA over localhost HTTP/SSE. Zero business logic, zero IPC, no preload. Electron pinned to 41 (ABI 145) — the newest major with official better-sqlite3 prebuilds; re-run the bump-gate in scripts/bundle.mjs before any bump.
